title: Note import request
description: Request body for POST /api/v1/decks/:id/notes, the bulk create or update endpoint. One request carries at most 500 notes. Each note names a note type of the deck in the path and sends its field values as a map from field name to HTML string. The server remains the source of truth for validation, but this schema mirrors the same constraints so external tools and agents can validate and generate request bodies before sending them.

dry_run.description: When true, the server counts created, updated and skipped notes and reports errors without writing anything.

on_conflict.description: What to do when a note with the same external_ref already exists in the deck. 'skip' leaves the existing note untouched, 'update' replaces its content, 'fail' aborts the request and rolls back.

notes.description: The notes to import. The array index is reported in the 'errors' entries of the response.

note.title: Note
note.description: One note. It names its note type with 'note_type', and 'fields' maps a field name of that note type to its HTML value.

note_type.description: Opaque public id of a note type of the deck in the path, as returned by GET /api/v1/decks/:id/note-types. The server maps every field name to the matching field id of this note type.

fields.description: Field values keyed by the note type's field name; every value is an HTML string, never Markdown and never a typed value such as a boolean, number or array. A field the payload omits becomes the empty string. An unknown field name is rejected and named in the per-row error.

external_ref.description: Idempotency key chosen by the caller, for example '<system>:<docId>:<blockId>'. The server never interprets it; it only guarantees that (deck_id, external_ref) is unique, so resubmitting the same batch creates no duplicates. Mutually exclusive with 'note_id'.

note_id.description: Opaque public id of an existing note in the deck addressed by the endpoint. The note is rewritten in place and its cards and every user's review progress are kept. Mutually exclusive with 'external_ref'; the note must belong to the deck in the path, and an unknown or deleted id is reported as a per-row error.

extra.description: Free-form metadata kept as-is for the caller and round-tripped on export. It is stored in the note's own column, not as a note type field. A note type that declares a field named 'extra' keeps that field instead.

source_url.description: Optional link back to the source the note was generated from. It is stored in the note's own column, not as a note type field. A note type that declares a field named 'source_url' keeps that field instead.

allOf.description: 'note_id' and 'external_ref' address a note in two different ways and are mutually exclusive; a note carrying both is rejected by the server.
